# GoScorer

`goscorer.py` and `LICENSE.txt` are vendored unchanged from lightvector/goscorer,
commit `0ac5f59962a9e40f39f4667645335ba5068acf86` (MIT).
https://github.com/lightvector/goscorer

Area/territory scoring requires user-confirmed dead stones. Japanese seki
handling is heuristic; disputed positions should be played out before scoring.
